newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound slips fractionally against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound slips fractionally against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound lost a fraction of its recent gains against the dollar on Monday in spite of more dollar inflows to the private sector market, bankers said.
"The market is still liquid. There are quite a lot of capital inflows," a banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3870 and 3.3885 pounds bid and at between 3.3890 and 3.3900 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Monday was 3.38775 pounds bid and 3.3894 pounds offered in the interbank market. These averages compared to 3.38666 pounds bid and 3.3895 pounds offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.386496 pounds buy and 3.391284 pounds sell .
